callers.name: single card partial payment
callers.reason: The assistant correctly identified the Yıldız Premium card ending in 2000 and provided the statement details for October 5, 2026, without asking. It accurately listed the TL debt (12,000 total, 4,800 min, 9,500 remaining total, 2,000 remaining min) and the Euro debt (85.20 total, 34.10 min). The assistant offered additional transactions (changing the date or sending an email) and redirected the user to the main menu following their expression of gratitude. The call ended properly via the end_call tool.
